ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The gray region in the figure is square ABCD, and triangle ADE is connected to one side AD of the square, so AD is the side length of the square. In the figure, AE is labeled 4√3, ∠EAD is labeled 30°, and AE and ED form a right angle, so triangle ADE is a right triangle, and AD is the hypotenuse. Reasoning: In right triangle ADE, it is known that ∠EAD = 30°, AE is the adjacent side of this angle, and AD is the hypotenuse, so cos 30° = AE / AD. Substituting cos 30° = √3/2 and AE = 4√3 gives √3/2 = 4√3 / AD, therefore AD = 8. The area of square ABCD is AD² = 8² = 64.
